newsitem.title: USA: Rohm and Haas forms alliance with Rodel Inc.
newsitem.headline: Rohm and Haas forms alliance with Rodel Inc.

text.p: Rohm and Haas Co, through its Shipley subsidiary, said Friday that it purchased a 25 percent interest in the privately-held Rodel Inc, a Delaware-based precision surface polishing technology company.
Rohm and Haas said it will obtain two seats on Rodel's board, but did not disclose what the 25-percent stake will cost.
Rohm and Haas said last month Shipley signed a letter of intent to purchase Pratta Electronic Materials Inc, of Manchester, N.H..
The company said it estimated the combined costs of the transactions to be about $75 million.
Shipley is an electronic chemicals firm headquartered in Marlborough, Mass., that became a wholly owned subsidiary of Rohm and Haas Company in 1992.
